records.source: Reuters, 17 Oct 2026 — Russia sanctions waiver and reactions
records.claim: The United States issued an executive order late Friday, October 16, waiving impending Russia-related sanctions and tariffs, including penalties linked to purchases of Russian energy. Reuters reported the decision on Saturday, October 17. The distinction matters: a new report on Saturday is not a second legal transition. The waiver changes the expected sanction environment; whether it creates additional physical oil or tanker supply remains unproven.
